note: The tags the HTML Standard's Rendering section lays out as block-level boxes or as a table or one of its parts: every
selector in that section's style sheet whose rule sets `display` to block, list-item, table, table-caption,
table-column, table-column-group, table-header-group, table-row-group, table-footer-group, table-row or table-cell,
read on 2026-09-09 from https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html (15.3.2 The page; 15.3.3 Flow content;
15.3.6 Sections and headings, whose `:heading` is h1 to h6; 15.3.7 Lists; 15.3.8 Tables; the details and summary
section; the form controls' sections, fieldset, option and optgroup). The value is the display the rule gives the element (a
summary first under a details is a list-item by a second rule; a closed dialog is hidden by one). The list is the
section's, whatever the sanitizer does: dialog, form, fieldset, legend, option and optgroup are on it and
md-sanitize.ts strips all six; listing, plaintext and xmp are on it and DOMPurify's allowlist lacks them. Two readers:
md-config-block-boxes.test.ts holds anchor-map.ts BLOCK_BOXES (the tags a whitespace-only text node between two of which is
skipped without a measurement, skipBlockWs) equal to these tags less the ones the sanitizer strips
or the parser never places in a fragment (html, body), in node, where CI runs;
md-config-paint-whitespace-browser.test.ts leg 1 holds this list to Chromium's computed display over the tags the
sanitizer keeps, where a browser exists.
